ConfirmActiveRequest.description: Someone `V redakci` says they still are: resets `Poslední potvrzení` and clears `Dotaz odeslán`. Writes nothing for anyone else, and answers `not_active`.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies one POST across its attempts. A repeat answers with the first result instead of writing again. Random per POST: a new press of a button is a new key, and the sheet decides.

idempotent.description: Present only on a repeat: an earlier call with this key did the work, and nothing was written now.

error.description: `not_found`: no named row on `Kontakty` has this address. `not_active`: the person is not `V redakci`. `not_removed`: the person is not `Vyřazení bez odpovědi`. `ambiguous`: rows with different names share this address. `busy`: no lock in time, worth trying again. `link_not_allowed`: the link is not on the confirmation route. `mail_send_failed`: the mail service did not take the e-mail, see `mailError`.

mailError.description: Present only when error is "mail_send_failed": the underlying reason.

EnrolRequest.description: Adds an application to `Přihlášky` as `Čeká na přijetí`, keyed by the address. One still waiting or with an empty `Stav` is refreshed. `Ověření e-mailu` is the day this request arrives. `Kontakty` is not touched.

formSubmittedAt.description: When the form was sent; its day lands in `Odeslání formuláře`.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies one POST across its attempts. A repeat answers with the first result instead of writing again. Random per POST: a new press of a button is a new key, and the sheet decides.

interest.description: What the person would like to work on; lands in `Zájem o činnost`.

name.description: The full name on one line, without an address or a link.

Envelope.description: How a request travels. `payload` is a request serialised to a string and signed as that exact string. OWN_SECRET is the signing key and never leaves either end.

payload.description: JSON of an EnrolRequest, a ConfirmActiveRequest, a LeaveRequest, a ReactivateRequest or a SendEnrolmentEmailRequest.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds. Inside the signature, so it cannot be adjusted.

LeaveRequest.description: Sets `Stav` to `Mimo redakci` and `Odchod či vyřazení` to today, unless the person is already out with a date, and clears `Dotaz odeslán`. Never deletes a row.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies one POST across its attempts. A repeat answers with the first result instead of writing again. Random per POST: a new press of a button is a new key, and the sheet decides.

ReactivateRequest.description: Someone removed without an answer says they are still in: for rows in `Vyřazení bez odpovědi`, sets `Stav` to `V redakci` and `Poslední potvrzení` to today, and clears `Odchod či vyřazení` and `Dotaz odeslán`. Writes nothing for anyone else, and answers `not_removed`.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies one POST across its attempts. A repeat answers with the first result instead of writing again. Random per POST: a new press of a button is a new key, and the sheet decides.

SendEnrolmentEmailRequest.description: Mails the link that confirms an enrolment, through the mail service. Touches no sheet and takes no lock. Has no idempotencyKey: the mail service recognises a repeat by a hash of `link`, which is minted per submission, so a retry of one request is one e-mail.

link.description: An https link on the site, on the confirmation route. Anything else answers `link_not_allowed`.

description: Contract for the writes to the Vedneměsíčník editorial-board spreadsheet and the e-mail that leads to one. POST a signed Envelope whose payload is an EnrolRequest, a ConfirmActiveRequest, a LeaveRequest, a ReactivateRequest or a SendEnrolmentEmailRequest; the response is an EditorialBoardMembershipResponse. Always replies HTTP 200, so `ok` is the only signal.
